question: Should OpenClaw accept provider-scoped alias precedence for provider/Alias session and chat model switches in this PR?
rationale: The implementation is the right layer for the reported bug, but it intentionally changes resolver precedence and persisted session override behavior, which is maintainer-owned compatibility risk.

options.title: Accept Scoped Alias Precedence
options.body: Merge this PR after exact-head checks pass because the shared resolver fix matches the reported session-persistence bug and preserves existing bare-alias behavior.

options.title: Require An Ambiguity Guard
options.body: Ask for a focused guard and regression test first if direct provider/model ids must always win over provider-scoped aliases in ambiguous configurations.

options.title: Pause For Broader Policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a wider model-selection policy decision before changing provider/Alias precedence.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Alias Precedence
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after exact-head checks pass because the shared resolver fix matches the reported session-persistence bug and preserves existing bare-alias behavior.
